data.description:
Each time you enable this module on your personal vehicle, choose a damage type: air, bolt, earth, fire or ice. Creatures aboard this personal vehicle gain Resistance to the chosen damage type until this module remains enabled.

Targets Gain: @EFFECT[pfu-anti-element-module-air], @EFFECT[pfu-anti-element-module-bolt], @EFFECT[pfu-anti-element-module-earth], @EFFECT[pfu-anti-element-module-fire], or @EFFECT[pfu-anti-element-module-ice]
